latestVersion.changelog:
**Initial release — Agent Notify enables cross-platform sound and taskbar notifications for AI coding agents.**

- Adds notification sounds and taskbar/dock flash for confirmation requests and task completion.
- Detects installed agent (Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Kiro, Cursor, etc.) and configures integration.
- Works on Windows, macOS, and Linux; auto-selects the correct notification script for your OS.
- Offers Quick Setup (default settings) or Custom Setup (user selects events, custom sounds, flash count).
- Guides users with simple prompts in English or Chinese, matching the user's language automatically.
